_doc: Every path the pipeline reads or writes. Relative paths are resolved against the repository root. Copy to configs/paths.local.json and pass --paths (or set SI_PATHS) to override on a given machine.
_model_dirs_doc: Optional local copies of parent weights, e.g. {"qwen3_32b": "/dev/shm/qwen3_32b"}. If absent, the pinned HF revision is resolved through the HF cache (HF_HOME).
